description:
What residents studied for their post-school qualification: engineering, health, management and commerce, IT, education, creative arts, trades and more, as counts and shares for every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 8,900 suburbs and localities and 543 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few people or homes for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/field-of-study`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_with_qualification, natural_and_physical_sciences_count, natural_and_physical_sciences_pct, information_technology_count, information_technology_pct, engineering_count, engineering_pct, architecture_and_building_count, architecture_and_building_pct, agriculture_and_environment_count, agriculture_and_environment_pct, health_count, health_pct, education_count, education_pct, management_and_commerce_count, management_and_commerce_pct, society_and_culture_count, society_and_culture_pct, creative_arts_count, creative_arts_pct, food_hospitality_and_personal_services_count, food_hospitality_and_personal_services_pct, mixed_field_programmes_count, mixed_field_programmes_pct, field_inadequately_described_count, field_inadequately_described_pct, field_not_stated_count, field_not_stated_pct. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
